title: Finite normalization and completed realization of the strict compact-support compositor
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi$, and $A_n=R/(\varpi^n)$ for $n\ge1$. All schemes and morphisms are separated of finite type over $k$. Use the operation datum [def-fix-six-functor-datum], the compactifications $c=(j,p_c)$ of [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and $F_f^c=Rp_{c*}j_!$ with its specified integral realization [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. Integral coefficients mean the completed ring sheaf $\widehat R_T=\varprojlim_n(A_n)_T$ on the small pro-etale site; $D^b_c(T,R)$ is the derived-complete category whose constructible finite reductions have cohomology in one interval independent of $n$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. 

Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ and supply a compatible compactification tower [lem-cbc-compactifiable-compatible-tower]: $Y\xrightarrow v\bar Y\xrightarrow bZ$, $X\xrightarrow a\bar X\xrightarrow p\bar Y$, $V=\bar X\times_{\bar Y}Y$, $t:V\hookrightarrow\bar X$, $r:V\to Y$, and $c:X\hookrightarrow V$, with $a=tc$. The maps $v,a,t,c$ are quasi-compact open and $b,p,r$ proper. In the constant-$R$ derived strict-tower category, write $P_u$ for total derived termwise direct image and $J_j$ for termwise open extension. Use the already constructed isomorphism
$$D_T:P_bJ_vP_rJ_c\xrightarrow{P_b\gamma_QJ_c}P_bP_pJ_tJ_c\xrightarrow{\sim}P_{bp}J_{tc},\qquad Q=(r,p,t,v),$$
and its refinement compatibility from [lem-cbc-complete-proetale-composition-pasting-coherence]; $\gamma_Q$ is the normalized mate of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus]. Its domain consists of towers whose evaluations are restrictions along $R\to A_n$ of bounded-below etale-origin complexes [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness].

Under the canonical finite coefficient-restriction and etale/pro-etale direct-image and open-extension comparisons, the $n$-th evaluation of this specified $D_T$ is exactly the composition transformation $\alpha_{g,f}:Rg_!Rf_!\to R(gf)_!$ of [thm-sf-comp-composition], with the supplied tower's compactification identifications. This identifies the actual transformations, not just their endpoints.

For $K\in D^b_c(X,R)$ with compatible finite-reduction witnesses put $N=\mathcal R(U_XK)$. Use the normalized completed-to-constant whole-word maps $q_W,a_W$ of [lem-sf-compactified-word-realization], where $U$ is coefficient restriction, $\mathcal R$ strict reduction and $\mathcal L$ total derived limit. Then
$$\alpha^R_{g,f,K}=a_{gf,K}^{-1}\mathcal L(D_{T,N})a_{g,f,K}:Rg_!Rf_!K\xrightarrow{\sim}R(gf)_!K$$
(read through $U_Z$) is the specified completed composition map. Its reduction is the finite $\alpha_{g,f,K_n}$ under the specified word reduction units. Here $a_{g,f,K}$ identifies the nested completed functors with the whole four-letter strict word, and $a_{gf,K}$ identifies the flattened two-letter word. These maps use the same intermediate vertex in every concatenation, with $q_{VW}=(\widetilde Vq_W)q_V$.

For a nested tower of three maps, the two realizations of the strict six-letter staircase are the same completed composition; identity towers realize the canonical identity. Thus the realized maps satisfy associativity and both unit equations, are independent of tower choices under the CBC refinement comparisons, and agree with the specified compact-support composition on $D^b_c$. This asserts the normalization of realization; invertibility and binary refinement compatibility of $D_T$ are supplied by the cited CBC theorem. No uniform integral Tor interval is required.

proof.text:
Evaluate the defining ordered composite, rather than choosing an isomorphism between its endpoints. By [lem-cbc-tower-mate-evaluation-scalars], evaluation commutes with the proper and open functors, their adjunctions and their canonical compositors, and restriction along $R\to A_n$ preserves the proper mate. By [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus], $\operatorname{ev}_n\gamma_Q$ is exactly the normalized finite proper/open comparison. Thus, writing $P^n,J^n$ for the finite functors, evaluation of $D_T$ is the restriction of
$$P_b^nJ_v^nP_r^nJ_c^n\xrightarrow{P_b^n\gamma_Q^nJ_c^n}P_b^nP_p^nJ_t^nJ_c^n\longrightarrow P_{bp}^nJ_{tc}^n.$$
The hypothesis on each evaluated input is exactly the bounded-below finite etale-origin hypothesis of the calculus. No bound common to all indices is used.

proof.text: The formula just obtained is the compatible-tower construction in Stacks 0F7J, with $(i,j,j',\bar f,\bar g,f')=(v,c,t,p,b,r)$. Apply [lem-sp-finite-site-tower-paste]: its named-map equation identifies this proper/open paste, including both compositors, with transport of the etale compositor through the canonical compact-support site comparisons. All schemes here are finite type over the field $k$, hence Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] (a field is Noetherian since its only ideals are $0$ and $1$). The pro-etale compositor of [thm-sf-comp-composition] is that transported compositor. Consequently the displayed evaluation is the specified $\alpha_{g,f}$ under the supplied compactification identifications. This uses the paste equation, not merely existence or invertibility of a composition isomorphism.

proof.text: Let $K\in D^b_c(X,R)$. The single-compactification comparison $d_c$ of [lem-fix-compactification-completed-realization] identifies each two-letter completed-ring word with precisely its defining quotient tower, and asserts that its open and proper intermediate objects are complete and constructible. Apply it successively to the compactifications of $f$ and $g$, and to the flattened compactification of $gf$; the output of the first application is an allowed input for the second. Hence [lem-sf-compactified-word-realization] applies to the four-letter and two-letter words. Set $A=Rg_!Rf_!K$, $B=R(gf)_!K$, $S=\widetilde W_{g,f}N$, $T=\widetilde W_{gf}N$, $N=\mathcal R(U_XK)$. Its actual maps give $a_A:U_ZA\cong\mathcal L S$, $a_B:U_ZB\cong\mathcal L T$, with $a=\mathcal L(q)\eta$. By [lem-cbc-complete-proetale-composition-pasting-coherence], $D_{T,N}:S\to T$ is invertible. Thus $a_B^{-1}\mathcal L(D_{T,N})a_A$ is a natural isomorphism. The equivalence on complete objects [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence] gives its unique completed-ring morphism.

proof.text:
Retain the finite module structures and quotient transitions. Use the actual strict semilinear categories and $\mathcal R\dashv\mathcal L$ of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. The proper/open mate of [lem-sf-semilinear-proper-open-mate-pasting], with the outside proper and open functors and the two compositors, defines $\delta:S^{\rm sys}\to T^{\rm sys}$. Termwise restriction to constant-$R$ towers identifies this actual mate with $D_T$, by the scalar-restriction assertion of the cited mate theorem.
Construct inverse word realizations $c_W:\mathcal L\widetilde W^{\rm sys}\mathcal RK\to WK$ recursively. At a variable use $u_K^{-1}$. At an open letter use exactly $d_j=u_{j_!K}^{-1}\mathcal L(r_j)^{-1}$ of [lem-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison]; at a proper letter use the inverse canonical direct-image/total-limit comparison of [lem-weil-ringed-tower-pushforward-limit-comparison] and the preceding vertex. At a concatenation insert the actual reduction/limit counit at its intermediate vertex. These maps are invertible: the open map is invertible for any complete input, and the proper comparison is invertible on all towers. In constant coordinates these are exactly $a_W^{-1}$ of [lem-sf-compactified-word-realization], which fixes the same generator maps, augmentation, and concatenation recursion. No finite Tor hypothesis enters this construction.

proof.text: Define $r_W=e_{M_W}\mathcal R(c_W^{-1})$, where $M_W=\widetilde W^{\rm sys}\mathcal RK$ and $e$ is the actual counit of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. This is the adjunction transpose of $c_W^{-1}$. Its finite evaluation is the scalar adjoint of the actual projection $WK\xrightarrow{c_W^{-1}}\mathcal LM_W\to\operatorname{Res}_nM_{W,n}$. The maps in step 4 commute with these projections: this is specified for proper direct image in [lem-weil-ringed-tower-pushforward-limit-comparison], and for open extension it follows by substituting $d_j^{-1}=\mathcal L(r_j)u_{j_!K}$ from [lem-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison]. Therefore for one letter this adjunct is the prescribed perfect-coefficient projection map or open-tensor map. For concatenation the inserted counit cancels the intermediate unit by $e_{\mathcal RH}\mathcal R(u_H)=1$; taking the scalar adjoint gives $r_{VW,n}=\widetilde V_n(r_{W,n})r_{V,WK,n}$. Induction identifies these finite maps with the specified word reduction units of [lem-sf-compactified-word-realization]. Each is invertible, so $r_W$ is invertible by the system isomorphism criterion. Hence $M_W$ is isomorphic to a reduction, and is normalized by [lem-pur-normalized-actual-reconstruction-maps]. This argues by adjunction with actual projections, not by reflecting equality through finite evaluation.

proof.text:
Define the completed comparison in system coordinates by $\alpha=c_{gf}\mathcal L(\delta)c_{g,f}^{-1}$. This is the map of step 3 by step 4 and the normalized realization of step 5. Naturality of the actual system counit gives
$$r_{gf}\,\mathcal R(\alpha)=\delta\,r_{g,f}.$$
Indeed substitute $r_V=e_V\mathcal R(c_V^{-1})$ at both vertices and cancel $\mathcal R(c_{gf}^{-1})\mathcal R(c_{gf})$; the remaining equation is $e_T\mathcal R\mathcal L(\delta)=\delta e_S$. Evaluate this equality in the finite module category, using the evaluation description of $e$ in [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. By steps 1--2 its right side is $\alpha_{g,f,K_n}r_{g,f,n}$. Hence the reduction is exactly the finite compositor under the specified word reduction units. This is an equality in $D(A_n)$ obtained from a system equation; no faithfulness of derived scalar restriction or finite evaluation is invoked.

proof.text:
On one supplied three-map staircase write its three elementary proper/open comparisons as $\mathsf A,\mathsf B,\mathsf C$, in the Stacks 0F7K arrangement. Start with the six-letter word $P_tJ_iP_qJ_dP_mJ_l$ and finish in $P_tP_sP_pJ_bJ_aJ_l$. Horizontal and vertical pasting in [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus] expand the two binary paths as
$$L=(P_tP_s\mathsf B J_aJ_l)(P_t\mathsf C P_rJ_aJ_l)(P_tJ_iP_q\mathsf A J_l),$$
$$R=(P_tP_s\mathsf B J_aJ_l)(P_tP_sJ_k\mathsf A J_l)(P_t\mathsf C J_dP_mJ_l).$$
Naturality of $\mathsf C:J_iP_q\to P_sJ_k$ at the morphism $\mathsf A:J_dP_m\to P_rJ_a$ equates the last two factors of these formulas. Whisker by $P_t$ and $J_l$, then postcompose by the common first factor to get $L=R$ before evaluation. The proper compositors are associative by [lem-cbc-strict-tower-direct-image-coherence]; the open compositors are associative by [lem-cbc-extension-zero-composition], applied termwise. The identical expansion and naturality calculation hold for the semilinear mates by [lem-sf-semilinear-proper-open-mate-pasting]. The semilinear compositors are associative and unital by [lem-sf-semilinear-compositor-coherence]. Thus this is also an equality of the system maps $\delta$, including transitions.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sf-expression-contextual-intertwining] to the complete/normalized-system equivalence of [lem-pur-normalized-actual-reconstruction-maps], using the actual unit and counit and the recursive word comparisons from step 5. Its coefficient hypothesis for the binary comparison is precisely the system equation proved in step 6. It therefore carries that comparison through every outer proper/open word context; this justifies the whiskered binary maps in the associativity diagram. The recursive word normalization of [lem-sf-compactified-word-realization] gives the same six-letter source vertex and the same flattened target vertex on both routes. Each intervening vertex occurs as $c_V^{-1}c_V$ and cancels. The two completed composites are therefore $c_{hgf}\mathcal L(L)c_{h,g,f}^{-1}$ and $c_{hgf}\mathcal L(R)c_{h,g,f}^{-1}$, equal by step 7. This proves completed associativity as equality of the specified maps.

proof.text: For either identity tower, the proper/open comparison is an identity by [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus]. The proper and open identity compositors then contract its strict word to the unchanged word, using [lem-cbc-strict-tower-direct-image-coherence] and [lem-cbc-extension-zero-composition]. For the empty word [lem-sf-compactified-word-realization] prescribes the completion unit, so the same vertex comparison occurs at both ends; conjugating the strict identity gives the identity. The contextual intertwining from step 8 gives each whiskered unit equation. Both left and right units therefore have the canonical, rather than a freely chosen, identity normalization.

The horizontal law gives $\Gamma_a=(\Gamma_TJ_{c_1})(J_{t_2}\Gamma_A)$ for $(a_1,a_2,1_X,x)$; the vertical law on both decompositions of $(t_1,v_2,r_1,p_2x=up_1)$ gives $(S_{p_2}\Gamma_T)(\Gamma_{Q_2}S_w)=(S_u\Gamma_{Q_1})(\Gamma_HS_{r_1})$; naturality of $\Gamma_{Q_2}$ at $\Gamma_A$ gives $(S_{p_2}J_{t_2}\Gamma_A)(\Gamma_{Q_2}J_{c_2})=(\Gamma_{Q_2}S_wJ_{c_1})(J_{v_2}S_{r_2}\Gamma_A)$. Substituting these in $S_{b_2}$ of the composite, with the associative compositors of [lem-sf-semilinear-compositor-coherence], gives $C^{s}_{gf}\delta_2=\delta_1(C^{s}_gF_{f,1})(F_{g,2}C^{s}_f)$ for $C^s_f=S_{r_2}\Gamma_A$, $C^s_g=S_{b_2}\Gamma_H$, $C^s_{gf}=S_{b_2}S_{p_2}\Gamma_a$, which restrict to the CBC maps. Apply $\mathcal L$, insert the word comparisons at the four vertices and cancel them by step 8. Refinement maps have identity, transitivity and cocycle laws by [lem-cbc-complete-proetale-refinement-exchange-coherence]; two towers have a common refining tower by the compatible-tower node.
